in_marathi.name: Ineshika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ine's Auspicious Sign
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ineshika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ineshika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ine’ which means ‘Goddess’ and ‘Shika’ which means ‘auspicious sign’. This name is believed to bring blessings of the Goddess and signify good luck and prosperity.
